desc:
Dress up for tonight's theme, strut the runway, and let the judges decide: SLAY or NAY? 💅

👗 DRESS UP: 4 minutes to style a look from thousands of real Roblox catalog pieces. Hair, tops, dresses, shoes, accessories and more!
✨ 100+ THEMES: Pirate Prom, Y2K Mall Day, Mermaid Ball, Winter Royalty... a new brief every round.
👑 MEET THE JUDGES: Vera wants the theme, Cleo wants colours that go together, Jett wants one bold statement piece. Impress all three!
🎤 WALK THE RUNWAY: show off your look with your own walk and pose while the crowd cheers.
🏆 WIN THE PODIUM: earn coins and ribbons, crown the audience's favourite, and vote on the next theme.
💃 MAKE IT YOURS: unlock new walks and poses, change your face and body, and save outfits in your Looks Book.
🛍️ LOVE YOUR LOOK? Buy the pieces you wore after the show.

Up to 6 models per show. Walk into a closet to join the next one!

👍 Like the game and join Pop Studio Games for updates!
